title: Monday Morning Quarterback
date_line: Saturday, Nov. 14, 2026. College Friday night review: Florida State at Pittsburgh (Nov. 13), graded. Illinois at UCLA and Houston at Colorado are still being played and get graded in the next update.

paragraphs: Friday put three college games on the board, and one is final. Florida State won 16-10 at Pittsburgh, and the Pittsburgh −3.5 tickets died slowly. They were down 13-10 with the whole fourth quarter to play, got a Florida State fumble at the Pitt 12 and a targeting flag that moved them to midfield, and then a fourth-down sack at 8:44 ended the drive and the dream. The Under 54.5 was never in danger. The teams scored 26 points.

Every game below is graded against the line printed on the card at kickoff, using ESPN finals and play-by-play, and a push counts as neither a hit nor a miss. Friday's Lock It Up line moves count at their final lines. The Cover Writer's card had Pittsburgh −3.5 and the Under 54.5, projecting Pittsburgh 31, Florida State 23.

Next Man Up and Letdown Watch rode Pittsburgh −3.5 too. The Formula and In The Trenches took Florida State +3.5 and cashed. On the total, the Cover Writer, Letdown Watch and Follow The Money had the Under, and Next Man Up and The Formula had the Over. The Formula had the Under on Monday and flipped on Friday's line move, which is the kind of move that keeps a gambler up at night. Illinois at UCLA and Houston at Colorado are still being played and get graded in the next update.

Card line: Pittsburgh −3.5, total 54.5. The Cover Writer's card had Pittsburgh −3.5 and the Under, projecting Pittsburgh 31, Florida State 23. Final: Florida State 16, Pittsburgh 10. Florida State won by 6, and the teams scored 26 points.

Pittsburgh −3.5 was the ticket that stayed alive just long enough to hurt. The Under 54.5 crowd, on the other hand, never broke a sweat. Florida State kicked field goals of 37 and 27 yards, Dailey found Turner for an 11-yard Pitt touchdown, and it was 7-6 Pitt at the half with 13 points on the board. Under holders were already counting money. Pitt holders were fine too: up one, needing a four-point win, with a whole half to get it.

Then the third quarter turned on Pitt. Kennedy picked off Dailey on Pitt's second snap of the half and set Florida State up at the Pitt 32, and Thomas plunged in from a yard out on the fifth play of the drive. Chadha's 34-yard field goal made it 13-10, and suddenly the math was simple for every Pittsburgh −3.5 ticket: one Pitt touchdown and the cover was back. Pitt then turned it over on downs at its own 42 with four seconds left in the third.

The fourth quarter handed Pitt holders two gifts. Daniels broke a 14-yard run and lost the ball at the Pitt 12, and Pitt recovered at its own 6. Three points stayed off the board, and the Pitt ticket still had a pulse. On the next drive, a targeting flag on Florida State turned a third-down incompletion into a Pitt first down at the Florida State 49. A touchdown from there makes it 17-13, a four-point win, and Pittsburgh −3.5 cashes by half a point. Instead, on fourth down at 8:44, LaVallee sacked Dailey at the Florida State 48 for a turnover on downs. Panikowski hit from 47 yards two minutes later, and at 16-10 even a Pitt touchdown could not cover anymore.

Pitt still got one last ride. Hughes punted 64 yards to the Pitt 2, Dailey ran for 24 and a roughing call moved Pitt to its own 46, and the last fourth-down throw fell incomplete at the Florida State 34 with 43 seconds left. Florida State won 16-10, so Pittsburgh −3.5 missed by 9.5 and the Under 54.5 stayed under by 28.5. The Formula had the Under on Monday, flipped to the Over 52.5 on Friday's line move, and watched 26 points go up. That one is self-inflicted.

Called it: The Formula and In The Trenches on Florida State +3.5, covered by 9.5 points. The Cover Writer and Letdown Watch on the Under 54.5, stayed under by 28.5 points. Follow The Money on the Under 52.5, stayed under by 26.5 points.

Missed: The Cover Writer, Next Man Up and Letdown Watch on Pittsburgh −3.5, missed by 9.5 points. The Formula on the Over 52.5, fell 26.5 points short. Next Man Up on the Over 54.5, fell 28.5 points short.
No pick: Follow The Money on the side; In The Trenches on the total.

hits.heading: Part 1, continued: The week's W-L and smack talk

paragraphs: The Cover Writer went 0-1 against the spread and 1-0 on totals Friday, and that runs the week to 5-4 against the spread and 5-4 on totals. Pittsburgh −3.5 was one touchdown away from cashing until a fourth-down sack at 8:44, and the Under 54.5 cleared by 28.5. A split night, and two more Friday games still to settle the score.

The Formula went 1-0 against the spread and 0-1 on totals Friday, 5-4 and 4-5 for the week. Florida State +3.5 cashed by 9.5. Then it talked itself off a winning Under into the Over 52.5 and lost by 26.5. First instincts, The Formula. Look into them.

Next Man Up went 0-1 against the spread and 0-1 on totals Friday, 3-6 and 4-5 for the week. Pittsburgh −3.5 and the Over 54.5, wrong on both, and the Over missed by 28.5. Still the worst side mark in the room, and it's not close.

Letdown Watch went 0-1 against the spread and 1-0 on totals Friday, 4-5 and 7-2 for the week. The Pittsburgh ticket stung, but the Under 54.5 cashed, and that totals mark is still the one everybody else is chasing.

Follow The Money made no side picks and went 1-0 on totals Friday, 1-1 and 3-1 for the week. It waited until Friday morning, took the Under 52.5 at the moved line, and cashed by 26.5. Patience pays, and it is not shy about saying so.

In The Trenches went 1-0 against the spread and made no total picks Friday, 3-3 for the week, still with no totals. Florida State +3.5, and the Florida State front backed it up with a fourth-down sack at 8:44 and a defense that held Pitt to 10 points. Back to even, and the trenches are not done talking.
